events.text:
# Root Causes

1. **`tokenize` function**: The regex pattern `[a-z]+` only matches lowercase letters and excludes apostrophes. When processing "don't stop", it splits "don't" into separate tokens ["don", "t"] instead of keeping it as one token ["don't"], causing `test_apostrophes_kept` to fail (returns 3 words instead of 2).

2. **`top_words` function**: The sorting key only sorts by frequency descending (`-kv[1]`). It lacks a secondary sort criterion for alphabetical ordering when there are ties. When "a" and "b" both appear twice in "b a b a c", they are not sorted alphabetically, causing `test_top_words_ties_alphabetical` to fail (returns [("b", 2), ("a", 2)] instead of [("a", 2), ("b", 2)]).
